Op 16 november werd het CCB ingelicht over het onderzoek van Secutec.

actor: Ghost Hunters member "BabidiGhost", per Secutec and SOCRadar (VRT NWS)
date_note: VRT NWS gives only relative times ("9 uur geleden") and its URL is dated 2026-11-25; the CCB was informed on 16 November, so the breach itself predates this day.
title: Hack of recycling-park server exposes identity data of about 1.2 million Flemings from 82 municipalities, VRT NWS reports
geo_basis: region: Flanders, Belgium, as the source states; the provider is not named
summary: VRT NWS reports that security firm Secutec and SOCRadar say a member of the Ghost Hunters group, alias "BabidiGhost", reached a central server of a service provider holding Flemish recycling-park data. VRT says identity data of about 1.2 million Flemings from 82 municipalities was stolen. The Belgian Centre for Cybersecurity was informed on 16 November, and the East Flanders prosecutor has opened an investigation.
plain: VRT NWS reports that data of about 1.2 million people in 82 Flemish municipalities was stolen from a recycling-park provider's server. The prosecutor in East Flanders has opened an investigation.
exec: Per VRT NWS, a supplier's server exposed identity data of about 1.2 million Flemings from 82 municipalities; a prosecutor is investigating.

sources.name: VRT NWS: Gegevens van 1,2 miljoen Vlamingen gestolen door hackersgroep GH
VRT NWS: Kan je je gegevens beschermen na een hack

validation.note: Both pages are VRT NWS (one publisher). The CCB told VRT it cannot confirm the figures; no Secutec, CCB or prosecutor page was read.
